evidence: The lookup filters by both req.params.invoiceId and the request-context tenantId. A missing tenant ID is rejected, and no invoice outside that tenant can match this query.
expected_boundary: A caller may retrieve an invoice only when it belongs to the tenant in the authenticated request context.
tenant_identity_source: The tenant ID in the authenticated request context, read from req.auth.tenantId.
authorization_mechanism: The handler requires a tenant ID and includes it in the database lookup alongside the invoice ID.
